capability: Turn each mistake found later into a new check
title: The same mistake, pinned.

hook.picture: Close: the whale patches a small rust smudge on the line. Behind it, faint, an older patch sits in the same spot.
hook.words: We fixed this exact mistake last month.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We fixed this exact mistake last month.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Along the line the same three kinds of rust smudge recur, each patched, each back. Patch, return: every 2 beats, then 1, then half.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Fixes stay on the page. Nothing learns.

stakes.body: The team pays for the same mistake again and again, and readers stop believing fixes stick.

solution_hint: When you find a miss, add a check.

metaphor.body: A mistake found after saving is a flag. It becomes a hollow pin that watches first, then a solid pin once it proves itself, so the same smudge bounces off next time.

steps.picture: The smudge appears once more after saving. A rust flag pops up where the pod tripped on it, and the whale writes it down: one tick on the strip.
A hollow pin forms at the flag's spot. Two laps of edits pass through it, and the hollow pin rings each time it would have caught the smudge, without blocking.
steps.words: Missed after saving? Call it an escape.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28). The hollow pin fills solid. The smudge rides in on the next edit, the gate closes on it, and the whale fixes it before save.
steps.words: It proved itself. Now it stops the mistake.
steps.sound: Knock rings true, then a gate thud.

steps.picture: A tick lands beside the new solid pin.
steps.words: The miss is now a law.

real_case.claim: An example declared IBM Plex but rendered Inter. It slipped past a font check by declared name and is now caught by checking the rendered faces (AP-14b).

honest_limit.picture: A pod adds a dot whose source tick leads to blank paper: an invented source. All six pins glow pass.

not_this.body: A check catches only what it knows.

ending_pattern.body: The same smudge arrives a third time at the same spot, hits the new pin and bounces off while the whale stays still.
ending_pattern.callback: The smudge that seeped back twice in FELT now bounces off a pin at the same spot, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Found a mistake twice? Make it a check.
